generators.title: Doom Metal Band Name Generator
generators.blurb: Slow, heavy, and a little bit cursed. Names for doom, sludge, and stoner metal bands.
generators.intro: Doom metal names tend to sound old, heavy, and worn down: a weight, a ritual, a ruined place. This generator pairs bleak adjectives with heavy nouns the way classic doom and sludge bands do. Click the button until one makes you want to tune down to C.

generators.title: Shoegaze Band Name Generator
generators.blurb: Hazy, soft, and drenched in reverb. Names for shoegaze and dream pop bands.
generators.intro: Shoegaze names usually sound like a blurry photo: soft words, pale colors, and feelings you can't quite name. This generator mixes gentle adjectives with dreamy nouns. Keep clicking until one sounds like a wall of fuzzy guitars.

generators.title: Bluegrass Band Name Generator
generators.blurb: Porch-ready names for bluegrass, old-time, and string bands.
generators.intro: Bluegrass bands love a place name, a critter, or a creek, usually followed by Boys, Ramblers, or String Band. This generator builds names from those same parts. Click until you find one that sounds like it already has a banjo player.

generators.title: Punk Band Name Generator
generators.blurb: Loud, rude, and easy to spray on a wall. Names for punk and hardcore bands.
generators.intro: A good punk name is short, a little gross, and looks right on a photocopied flyer. This generator smashes blunt adjectives into everyday nouns. Click until one makes you laugh or wince.

generators.title: Synthwave Artist Name Generator
generators.blurb: Neon, chrome, and midnight drives. Names for synthwave and retrowave projects.
generators.intro: Synthwave names sound like the title of a 1984 action movie you rented on tape. This generator pairs neon adjectives with night-drive nouns, and sometimes adds a year. Click until one feels like a sunset over a grid.

generators.title: Jam Band Name Generator
generators.blurb: Goofy, groovy, and festival-ready. Names for jam bands and funk outfits.
generators.intro: Jam band names are friendly nonsense: a food, an animal, and a vague sense that the set will run long. This generator stirs silly adjectives and odd nouns together. Click until one sounds like a twenty-minute solo.
